questions.text: Which of the following best describes your prior exposure to C programming and systems-level development?
options: No prior exposure: I have never programmed in C or worked with systems-level code.
Some prior exposure: I have written basic programs in C or used a command-line interface.
Strong prior exposure: I am comfortable with pointers, manual memory management, and systems programming.

questions.text: From your prerequisite courses (CS-UH 1052 and 2010), which of the following areas do you feel most confident in? (Select all that apply)
options: Memory Addressing and Pointers
Data Structures (linked lists, queues)
CPU Architecture/Instruction Sets
Command-line (Unix/Linux) proficiency
